description: Get summarized UCR crime data from the FBI at national, state, or agency level. Covers 10 offense categories: V (violent crime), P (property crime), HOM (homicide), RPE (rape), ROB (robbery), ASS (aggravated assault), BUR (burglary), LAR (larceny/theft), MVT (motor vehicle theft), ARS (arson). Returns year-by-year data with counts and rates.

offense.description: UCR offense code: 'V' (Violent Crime), 'P' (Property Crime), 'HOM' (Homicide), 'RPE' (Rape), 'ROB' (Robbery), 'ASS' (Aggravated Assault), 'BUR' (Burglary), 'LAR' (Larceny/Theft), 'MVT' (Motor Vehicle Theft), 'ARS' (Arson)

ori.description: Agency ORI code for agency-level data (e.g., 'WASPD0000')

state.description: Two-letter state abbreviation for state-level data

name: fbi_crime_summarized
